title: The per-scenario record of one conformance run: for each language, one outcome per scenario file, with the run it came from. The runner writes it beside matrix.json when the run held the whole suite; it is a run artifact and is not committed.

commit.description: The commit the run held, as git names HEAD, or "unknown" where git could not say.

dirty.description: True where the tree differed from the commit when the run was written.

url.description: The CI run, where the environment named one.

additionalProperties.description: One entry per scenario file, keyed by its path under conformance/.

name.description: The scenario's name as its file gives it.

profile.description: The profile the placement rule gave it.

outcome.description: failed when any run failed, else skipped when any run was skipped, else passed.

skips.description: Every distinct reason a run was skipped, as the runner gave it.

run.description: The run's name: the scenario's, with the row a foreach bound and a mirror marked.

pair.description: The pairing it ran in, as a-with-b.
